sections.title: Put the shopping language together
sections.content: Combine food vocabulary, quantities, *querer* and *necesitar* to make a simple shopping interaction.

items.spanish: Quiero dos manzanas y un kilo de arroz.
items.english: I want two apples and a kilo of rice.
I need a bottle of water.
How many tomatoes do you want?

sections.content: In a short shopping exchange, give the quantity and the item clearly: *dos* *manzanas*, *un* *kilo* *de* *arroz*, *una* *botella* *de* *agua*.
